notes: Tail case: U1 now recolours only the silver alloy rim (target_part, v2 rim mask); U2 bucket replaced by a toolbox with v2 mask = bucket plus its contents; U3 thin shelf-edge strip retargeted to the black plastic chair at the far left (v2 SAM3 mask); U4 bag ref made precise and payload specific.

spec.ref: the Bridgestone wheel the mechanic is leaning over

units.ref_zh: 机修工俯身处理的普利司通车轮
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将机修工俯身处理的普利司通车轮的银色合金轮辋的颜色改为哑光黑。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域的颜色改为哑光黑。
units.reason: Recolouring the whole wheel to black was near no-op for the black tyre; edit now targets the silver alloy rim, and the v2 mask is the rim only (SAM3, viewed).

spec.ref: the white NIPPON PAINT bucket full of metal parts at the lower right

units.ref_zh: 右下方装满金属零件的白色NIPPON PAINT油漆桶
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将右下方装满金属零件的白色NIPPON PAINT油漆桶替换为一个红色金属工具箱。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一个红色金属工具箱。
units.reason: 'a blue bucket' was a recolour; now a structural replacement. The old mask excluded the parts filling the bucket opening; v2 mask = bucket plus contents (occluding cable excluded).

spec.ref: the black plastic chair at the far left in front of the oil shelves

units.ref_zh: 最左侧机油货架前的黑色塑料椅
units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除最左侧机油货架前的黑色塑料椅。
units.reason: Retarget: old mask was a 19-px front strip of a loaded shelf board (ill-defined removal). New target is the fully visible black plastic chair at the far left (a second chair is mostly hidden behind the mechanic); SAM3 mask viewed.

spec.ref: the clear plastic bag of crushed cans hanging at the far right edge

units.ref_zh: 最右边缘悬挂的装压扁易拉罐的透明塑料袋
units.instruction_ref_zh: 给最右边缘悬挂的装压扁易拉罐的透明塑料袋系上一枚红色纸质价签。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域系上一枚红色纸质价签。
units.reason: Two hanging bags of cans; masked one is at the far right edge. Generic 'small label' made specific.
